import struct

# Read an existing BAM file to understand the format
with open('/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/htslib/test/range.bam', 'rb') as f:
    data = f.read()

print(f"File size: {len(data)} bytes")
print(f"First 4 bytes: {data[:4]}")
print(f"Hex: {data[:50].hex()}")

# Parse BGZF blocks
pos = 0
block_num = 0
while pos < len(data):
    if data[pos:pos+2] != b'\x1f\x8b':
        print(f"Not a valid GZIP header at offset {pos}")
        break
    
    # Parse BGZF extra field to get block size
    # GZIP header: 10 bytes fixed + 2 bytes XLEN
    xlen = struct.unpack('<H', data[pos+10:pos+12])[0]
    # BGZF subfield: SI1, SI2, length (2), BSIZE (2)
    bsize = struct.unpack('<H', data[pos+14:pos+16])[0]
    
    print(f"Block {block_num}: offset={pos}, XLEN={xlen}, BSIZE={bsize}")
    
    # Decompress
    compressed_start = pos + 12 + xlen
    compressed_end = pos + bsize - 8  # minus footer
    footer_start = compressed_end
    
    import zlib
    try:
        decompressed = zlib.decompress(data[compressed_start:compressed_end], -15)
        print(f"  Decompressed: {len(decompressed)} bytes")
        print(f"  First 20 bytes hex: {decompressed[:20].hex()}")
        
        if decompressed[:4] == b'BAM\x01':
            print("  -> BAM header found!")
            hdr_len = struct.unpack('<I', decompressed[4:8])[0]
            print(f"  -> Header text length: {hdr_len}")
            print(f"  -> Header text: {decompressed[8:8+hdr_len]}")
            n_ref = struct.unpack('<I', decompressed[8+hdr_len:12+hdr_len])[0]
            print(f"  -> n_ref: {n_ref}")
            
            # Parse refs
            ref_pos = 12 + hdr_len
            for i in range(n_ref):
                ref_name_len = struct.unpack('<I', decompressed[ref_pos:ref_pos+4])[0]
                ref_name = decompressed[ref_pos+4:ref_pos+4+ref_name_len-1]  # -1 for NUL
                ref_len = struct.unpack('<I', decompressed[ref_pos+4+ref_name_len:ref_pos+8+ref_name_len])[0]
                print(f"  -> Ref {i}: name={ref_name}, len={ref_len}")
                ref_pos += 8 + ref_name_len
            
            # Parse alignments
            align_num = 0
            while ref_pos < len(decompressed):
                block_size = struct.unpack('<I', decompressed[ref_pos:ref_pos+4])[0]
                if block_size < 32:
                    print(f"  -> Alignment {align_num}: block_size={block_size} (too small, end of data)")
                    break
                core = decompressed[ref_pos+4:ref_pos+36]
                ref_id, pos, bin_mq_nl, flag_nc, l_seq, next_ref, next_pos, tlen = struct.unpack('<iiIIiiii', core)
                l_qname = bin_mq_nl & 0xff
                mapq = (bin_mq_nl >> 8) & 0xff
                bin_val = (bin_mq_nl >> 16) & 0xffff
                n_cigar = flag_nc & 0xffff
                flag = (flag_nc >> 16) & 0xffff
                
                qname_data = decompressed[ref_pos+36:ref_pos+36+l_qname]
                print(f"  -> Alignment {align_num}: ref={ref_id}, pos={pos}, l_qname={l_qname}, n_cigar={n_cigar}, l_seq={l_seq}")
                print(f"     qname hex: {qname_data.hex()}")
                print(f"     qname repr: {repr(qname_data)}")
                
                ref_pos += 4 + block_size
                align_num += 1
                if align_num > 5:
                    break
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"  Error: {e}")
    
    pos += bsize
    block_num += 1
    if block_num > 5:
        break
PYEOF
